brief_summary: This study investigated the effect of glutamine, an amino acid, glycemia, glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) and insulin in participants with type 2 diabetes.
brief_title: Effects of Glutamine on GLP-1 and Insulin Secretion in Man

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Type 2 diabetes, on metformin or diet alone (not sulphonylureas or insulin)

Exclusion Criteria:

* Malabsorption, renal or liver disease, treatment with steroids

official_title: Study of the Effects of Glutamine on Glycemia, Glucagon-like Peptide-1 (GLP-1) and Insulin Secretion in Man

primary_outcomes.measure: Postprandial Glucose Area Under the Curve (AUC)
